comment: The fort emitter's table. src/fort/gen.ft, gen_expr.ft, gen_stmt.ft and
gen_data.ft cited 86 decisions, D16 (5 bare citations), 19 items of
spec/toolchain.md 6 and 2 sections of that file at a3e0c95d, the last
tree with citations. gen_fir.ft cites toolchain.md 1 today. Each has a
row here, except four. No emitter line implements D2.4 or D9.5 (the
lexer refuses a reserved word, and modules.ft refuses an import cycle).
The emitter lines of D4.4 and D17.8 are panics that no compile reaches,
because flt_from_int never fails for an integer constant and the
checker refuses a discarded `move`. tools/panic_coverage.py holds them.
Rows whose name ends in a letter are further facets; D10.8 stands
outside the cited universe. b0606efa replaced the direct emitter by the
FIR path, so each row names the current line that decides the rule.
The stages are targeted: the FIR corpus, the gen_ and fir_ module
suites, the driver_ module suites and four areas of the language
corpus. The table runs on a darwin host with --runner 'bash -c';
The md5 guard reads the product compiler that the build links.
